comment: Template for the cooperative member database lookup mapping.
Copy this file OUTSIDE the repository, replace every <PLACEHOLDER> with the value confirmed by
the cooperative's DBA, and supply it through the MEMBER_DB_* environment variables (or by
passing a mapping object to resolveMemberDirectory).
NO TABLE NAME, COLUMN NAME, PACKAGE NAME, OR CONNECTION STRING IS INVENTED HERE. Every value is
a placeholder until the real schema is supplied. validateMemberDatabaseMapping refuses to run
while any required value is still an unresolved <PLACEHOLDER>.
THIS FILE MUST NEVER CONTAIN A CREDENTIAL. No username, password, wallet path, DSN, or
connection string. The database connection is owned by the host application's driver, which
implements MemberDatabaseClient; this mapping only describes the query and its result columns.
requirements: lookupSql MUST be a single read-only SELECT (or WITH) statement.
lookupSql MUST match the citizen ID with an exact equality on the bind parameter.
lookupSql MUST NOT contain a literal citizen ID; the value is always bound as a parameter.
lookupSql MUST NOT apply its own row limit (no ROWNUM = 1, FETCH FIRST 1 ROW, TOP 1, LIMIT 1).
A limit would hide duplicate member rows, and duplicates must fail closed, not be silently
lookupSql MUST NOT select the citizen ID column into the result set; the identifier goes in as
a lookup key and does not come back out.
photoReference MUST be an identifier (URL, key, or id) for a photo the cooperative system
already holds. It MUST NOT be image bytes or a BLOB column.
